How to Fix a 503 Error After Deploying Your App

A 503 after deploy almost always means one thing: your app process isn't up and answering on the port the server expects. So read `app.error.log` first, don't guess. In practice the cause is usually small.

How to Fix a 503 Error After Deploying Your App

Quick thread 🧵
A 503 after deploy almost always means one thing: your app process isn't up and answering on the port the server expects.
In practice the cause is usually small.
The app isn't listening on `process.env.PORT`, or a required environment variable never got set on the server.
